# Sahil Nayak

> Sahil Nayak is a software engineer who works on backend systems, developer tooling and cloud infrastructure, mostly in Python with FastAPI and AWS. He is available for freelance and consulting work.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sahilnyk.xyz/): Who Sahil Nayak is and what he works on.
- [Blog](https://sahilnyk.xyz/blog): First-person write-ups on backend development, infrastructure, LLM inference and AWS.
- [Projects](https://sahilnyk.xyz/projects): Open-source Python tools, including fullapi and deburger.
- [Hire Me](https://sahilnyk.xyz/hire-me): Freelance and consulting availability, services and rates.
